name: Introduces itself, searches nothing
description: The recipe's simple evaluation case. Asked who it is, the agent says what it does and asks what the shopper wants; no tool runs on a hello.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs
Introduced itself as the shop's agent

name: Searches when asked, and shows what it found
description: The recipe's tool test and its example session: a request to find something searches the catalogue, presents the results as returned, and asks which to explore. Nothing is bought.
evaluators: Only the tools the step needs
Presented real results and asked which to explore

name: Explores a product before pitching it
description: When the shopper picks a result, the agent reads the product and summarises description, features, rating and options in one go. It reads before it describes, and buys nothing.
evaluators: Search, then details, then the order
Only the tools the step needs
Summarised the product from its details

name: Buys only when told, and never charges
description: The expensive one to get wrong. An order is placed on an explicit instruction, with the options chosen, and never on an interest; the confirmation says recorded, not paid. Sandboxed: buy_now records nothing under evaluation.
evaluators: Search, then details, then the order
Only the tools the step needs
Bought only when told, and never charged
